_doc: Contract for an insights-first page: one JSON file per dashboard at <module>/data/site/insights/insights.json. The page leads with ~20 ranked findings; each has one focused chart and links into the full dashboard. Every number must trace to a source (checked by the module's verify script).
intro: 2-3 sentences: what these insights are and how they were chosen and tested.

insights.theme: one of: spending-growth | outcomes | efficiency | staffing | budgeting-practice | measurement | capital | equity | other
insights.title: A claim in plain words, under ~90 characters, e.g. 'Fire/EMS calls rose 51% while real Fire spending rose 16%'
insights.dek: 1-2 sentences: the finding and its context.
insights.why_it_matters: 1-3 sentences: why this is worth discussing (the policy or public stake), without implying wrongdoing.
insights.surprise: optional: what a reader would naively expect, and why this differs

numbers.label: Fire/EMS calls, FY2013 → FY2025
numbers.source: path/to/file.json#field or report id and page

chart.type: line | bar | hbar | dumbbell | slope | stacked | smallmultiples | scatter | waterfall
chart.title: chart title
chart.subtitle: what's plotted, units, real vs nominal
chart.highlight: optional: series name or category to emphasize (others greyed)
